theses.thesis: Banks is the durable leader — highest score (1.313), solid durability_bar (0.67), highest breadth (0.692), eligible under the trend gate, and not crowded (crowding_z 0.93). If the macro backdrop (unscheduled_share 0.75, geopolitics dominant) turns risk-off, bank shares often lead declines. High breadth and durability can simply mean the move is already mature and closer to a top.
